description: Official .NET SDK for RAAIN Guard, the embedded decision-intelligence platform for business software.

A WPF-specific NuGet package providing window management services, dialog and notification helpers, and region (tab-based area) management for MVVM applications. Uses a factory-based configuration pattern — map ViewModel types to views and let the services handle creation, ownership, and lifecycle.…
Background job contracts for JoinRpg web infrastructure: IJob, IJobRepository, job runner and registration helpers.
